desc: The North American Arms Recluse .22 Magnum Mini Revolver delivers the trusted craftsmanship of NAA in a compact, easy-to-carry design. Built on the Magnum frame, the Recluse features a brushed stainless steel finish, larger rubber grips, and a 1 1/8-inch barrel for a comfortable balance of concealability and control. Designed with everyday carry in mind, the Recluse combines a lightweight stainless steel construction with a five-shot capacity and classic single-action operation. The larger grip provides a more secure hold while maintaining the small profile that makes NAA mini revolvers popular among those looking for a compact .22 Magnum option.
